notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.content:
The team at Digital Continue is excited to share JumpStream with everyone! This project was enabled by Mixer, a streaming technology that enables interaction between the person playing, and the audience watching. Our game allows for viewers to build 2D platforming levels in real time for the person playing. Every play session is different, as there are unlimited ways to build in order to secure the keys and complete the challenge. All times are tracked on the leaderboards, and we're excited to see what emergent and innovative paths to success ours players choose!

Please join our community at https://discord.gg/digitalcontinue

We are constantly adding more to the game, so stay tuned in Discord or here on Steam for more updates and news!
